title: Walter Barnes's instrument and sidemen
summary: Barnes played tenor sax; the interviewers run through his sidemen, and McAllister met most but knew none locally.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What did Walter Bond play mostly?
Mostly tenor or alto or what?
I don't know whether he doubled or clarinet or not.
Mostly tenor. Every time I seen him, he was playing sax.
Do you remember Ed Burke or Bradley Bullock? They were trombone players with Walter Bond? I don't know. What about, uh, Lucius Wilson? He played tenor.
But he wasn't from here, huh? No. He had a couple of alto players, Irby Gage and Wilson Underwood.
I met all those fellas, but I, I, they.
What do I just want to check? Paul Johnson, a piano player?
But again, not from Natchez. Not from Natchez. And Blanca Hall was a banjo player. Not from here. Lewis Thompson bass?

He played tuba, I'm not. Yeah, he probably even played Mighty Fine tuba. And Bill Winston drums. No, you don't remember those? Well, it's nice to know I never could quite get those guys lined up. There's so many Mississippi musicians. What bands passed through Natchez from other towns that you'd hear?
